lead.headline: Kindred's 42 long-term hospitals book $178M a year more expense than Medicare's cost line; the peer gap is accounting
lead.number: A fast-growing $178M-a-year gap between booked expense and Medicare's cost figure; on Medicare's cost line the Kindred-vs-peer margin gap shrinks from 9.4 points to 0.8.
lead.watch_out: Kindred's -6.7% vs +2.7% margin is on booked expense; on Medicare's cost line the gap is 0.8 points and the same-state test falls from 11 of 13 states to 7 of 13.
